items.title: Continuous images of quasi-compact spaces are quasi-compact, and quasi-compact maps have retrocompact image
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the two image properties of quasi-compact spaces and maps (author lemma at source lines 1963-1970, label lemma-image-quasi-compact): a continuous image of a quasi-compact space is quasi-compact, and the image of a quasi-compact map is retrocompact. The proof (source lines 1972-1982) proves the first part by pulling back coverings (proof lines 1973-1977) and verifies retrocompactness directly for the second (proof lines 1977-1981). Together with the corresponding statements for Noetherian and constructible sets these are the basic image properties used throughout the chapter. H2.
